assessment: The manuscript by Wiesinger et al., demonstrates the differentiation of human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) into pacemaker cardiomyocytes. Authors have shown impressive analyses of sinoatrial node cardiomyocytes (SANCM) using scRNA-seq followed by a computational method namely Trajectory Inference (TI) to understand the diversification of SAN subtypes. The study further shows a key role for Wnt signaling in the critical branching of pacemaker cardiomyocytes and/or pro-epicardial cells. The authors also demonstrate that active TGFβ signaling promotes differentiation towards SAN transitional cells.
